Local browser OCR assets. Reproduce with npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm run vendor in tools/ocr. Versions are pinned in package-lock.json. PDF.js and Tesseract.js are Apache-2.0; see the included LICENSE files. Language npm packages declare MIT; package metadata and README files are retained in lang/. Source: https://github.com/naptha/tessdata ; upstream models: https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata . No student files are sent to npm or a CDN.
